name: VSO Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: VSO Electronics Co., Ltd. is a company that specializes in producing both connectivity solutions and advanced functional materials. Their extensive product line includes essential cabling for industrial automation and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, as well as connection cables designed for cloud infrastructure and fifth-generation (5G) applications. The firm also supplies various optical materials. Established by Chung Cheng Chien on August 13, 1994, the company's headquarters are situated in New Taipei, Taiwan.
